memo: Clock: 6.6 days remain on verification notice (due 2026-07-24 23:59). Exemption conflict: member claims caretaker exemption (believes it covers the 15-year-old), but EX-CARETAKER states the exemption covers 'a dependent child age 13 or younger' — the child is 15, so the exemption does not fit the rule as written. Screening flags this as unsupported and warns not to rely on it without navigator confirmation. Hours: member has reported zero qualifying hours and is 80 hours short. No documents on hand. Member has essentially halted reporting based on the exemption belief. DECISION: Facts in conflict (claimed exemption vs. rule language on child age) + tight deadline + zero hours + zero documents = this case requires human navigator review immediately. Navigator should confirm the child's age/dependency status and help the member execute a response plan (either locate correct exemption if one applies, or gather 80 qualifying work/activity hours from past or current month plus supporting documents) within the 6-day window. The 30-day cure window exists if the notice deadline passes, but best path is to respond now.
member_impact: We need to talk with you right away—you have 6 days left to respond to your renewal notice. You believe the caretaker exemption covers your 15-year-old, but the rule says the exemption is for children age 13 or younger. A helper can work with you to figure this out and get it done before the deadline. Please contact [program] today to talk to someone who can help—this is free and fast.
missing_documents: Proof of qualifying work or activities (80+ hours: pay stubs, employer letter, school enrollment, job training certificate, community service record, or self-attestation with employer contact)
recommended_actions: Contact program navigator immediately to clarify child age and exemption eligibility
If exemption does not apply, gather all work/activity documentation from past month (pay stubs, employer letters, school proof, etc.)
If work is informal/cash-paid, obtain employer letter or sign self-attestation with employer contact info
Submit response before 2026-07-24 23:59 (6 days); if deadline passes, 30-day cure window applies after non-compliance notice
